Raw Banana Powder Price Per Kg for Global Markets

Raw banana powder, also known as green banana flour, is made from unripe bananas that are dehydrated and milled to a fine, cream-coloured powder. Bakeries, snack makers, food brands and ingredient distributors buy it as a neutral-tasting base for flours, bars and mixes. If you are comparing the raw banana powder price per kg, Tradenest Naturals offers clear wholesale pricing from a 5 Kg MOQ. Because we process in-house, we can keep each batch close to the agreed specification. As a raw banana powder exporter in India, we process mature, unripe bananas under hygienic, controlled conditions. Careful drying helps keep the light colour and mild flavour of the green fruit. As a bulk raw banana powder supplier, we ship worldwide from India with export documentation support. Whether you need wholesale raw banana powder for baking or for dry food mixes, we can plan volumes around your production.

Manufacturing Process and Quality Control

Our raw material is green bananas, carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. First, the bananas are peeled, washed and sliced. Next, the slices are dehydrated at controlled temperatures to protect colour and flavour. Finally, the dried slices are milled and sieved to a fine, even powder. As green banana powder manufacturers in India, we check every batch for moisture and mesh before packing. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Our raw banana powder wholesale supply is designed for food brands that need repeatable results. Our raw banana flour programme also keeps batch traceability from raw material to export packing. Because each step happens under one roof, buyers get steady colour, texture and moisture from one order to the next.

Key Technical Specifications and Characteristics

Clear specifications matter for industrial formulation. Our raw banana powder has an even light cream to off-white colour. It has a neutral, mildly starchy taste that blends easily into many recipes. Moisture is held below 8% to limit caking. The standard 80-100 mesh grade gives a smooth texture in commercial kitchens and production lines.
  • Purity: Single-ingredient green banana powder with no added additives or preservatives.
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 mesh for smooth blending.
  • Moisture: Below 8% for stable storage.
  • Shelf Life: 24 months when stored under recommended conditions.

Versatile Applications Across Industries

Food developers use wholesale raw banana powder in many products. Bakeries add it to breads, cookies and snack bars, including recipes made without wheat flour. Food brands use it as a thickener in soups, sauces and dry mixes. Traditional Indian recipes use it for flatbreads, porridges and snacks. Beverage brands also blend it into smoothie and shake powders.

Packaging Options and Global Export Support

Good packaging protects the powder on long journeys. We offer export packaging including 1 kg stand-up pouches, 5 kg bags, 25 kg multi-wall paper sacks and HDPE drums. Each container has a sealed closure and clear labels with batch number and production date. OEM and private label packing is available. As an IEC registered exporter, we also handle the export documents for smooth customs clearance.

Frequently Asked Questions

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Contact our sales team for pricing at larger volumes.

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

We pack in moisture-resistant bags and drums from 1 kg to 25 kg. Shelf life is 24 months.

Lead time depends on order size and packaging, and we confirm it with each quotation. Request a quote or a sample through our website.
